name: facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/mdr/retrieval/utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.tokenize_text_with_regexp: create a python module that uses RegexpTokenizer to tokenize text into tokens with whitespace and span info
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.tokenize_text_with_simple: create a python module that uses SimpleTokenizer to tokenize text into basic alphanumeric and non-whitespace tokens
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.extract_ngrams_from_tokens: build a python script that extracts n-grams from tokenized text using the Tokens ngrams method
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.filter_stopwords_and_punctuation: create a function that filters out English stopwords and punctuation using filter_word and filter_ngram
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.normalize_unicode_text: build a python module that normalizes unicode text encodings using the normalize function

facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.pick_bridge_v0: pick the bridge passage title between two candidates using answer presence and link structure
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.normalize_answer: normalize an answer string by lowercasing, removing punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.add_sp_labels: add sentence-level supervision labels to retrieved HotpotQA results using original supporting facts
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.load_annotated: load annotated Wikipedia abstracts and return title-to-document and title-to-linked mappings
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.explore_QDMR: explore question decomposition data from the BREAK dataset and align it with HotpotQA entries

facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.tokenize_text_with_basic_tokenizer: create a BasicTokenizer instance and tokenize a piece of text with lowercasing and accent stripping
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.convert_tokens_to_ids: convert a list of tokens into their corresponding vocabulary IDs using convert_tokens_to_ids
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.whitespace_tokenize_text: split a string into tokens by whitespace using the whitespace_tokenize function
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.strip_accents_from_text: use BasicTokenizer _run_strip_accents to remove diacritical marks from Unicode text
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.split_text_on_punctuation: use BasicTokenizer _run_split_on_punc to split text into tokens at punctuation boundaries

facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.load_saved_model: load a PyTorch model's saved state dict from a file path and apply it to the model
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.move_tensors_to_cuda: recursively move all PyTorch tensors in a nested dict or list sample to CUDA device
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.convert_tensors_to_half: recursively convert all FloatTensor tensors in a nested dict or list sample to half precision
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.query_doc_text_from_sqlite: fetch the raw text of a document by its ID from a SQLite-backed document database
facebookresearch_multihopdenseretrieval/.check_paragraph_has_answer: check if a paragraph contains any of the given answers using tokenized exact match
